_comment_tiers: S159: rates verified against each vendor's pricing page on 2026-09-11. Two shapes this flat table cannot express, resolved CONSERVATIVELY so the ledger can overstate but never understate. (1) PROMPT-SIZE TIERS -- gemini-3.1-pro-preview, the grok-4.20 family and grok-4.5 all double above 200k prompt tokens; the rate here is the <=200k tier, which is where every call we make sits (the largest real prompt measured is far under it). A >200k call would be costed at half its true price -- if we ever start sending them, this table needs a tier-aware cost_usd, not a bigger number. (2) DEEPSEEK OFF-PEAK -- deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro bill at HALF these rates outside 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC Mon-Fri. The PEAK rate is recorded, so DeepSeek lines read as a ceiling. Deliberately still unpriced: deepseek-v4-flash (delisted -- no vendor page left to verify, and the real fix is to stop calling it, see the worklist), and the probe stubs '?', 'srv', 'm', 'gpt-x', 'gemini-9', which are not models.
